//: The seven files under ../src/lib are listed one by one on purpose. A glob over ../src/lib pulls the whole web tree into this program, including server-only modules that import through the `@/` alias this config knows nothing about and that have no business being compiled for a phone. These seven are the ones mobile/src/shared.ts re-exports, they are the only ones the app imports, and they resolve each other with relative paths only.
